topic: Garmi/barsaat mein operation nahi karwana chahiye?

cap.q: Uncle: "Doctor Madam, garmi-barsaat mein operation nahi karwana chahiye?"
cap.a: Dr Saathi: "Uncle, mausam nahi, taiyaari dekhiye!"
cap.f: Mausam se zyada safai zaroori. Garmi mein infection ka farak bahut thoda hota hai.
cap.f2: Operation se pehle sabun se nahaiye. Ghaav saaf-sookha rakhiye; laali, pus ya bukhaar ho toh turant doctor ko dikhaiye.

Uncle ne poocha: "Garmi-barsaat mein operation nahi karwana chahiye?" ☀️🌧️
Dr Saathi ne kaha: Uncle, mausam nahi — taiyaari dekhiye! 💚

Sach kya hai?
✅ Mausam se zyada zaroori hai saaf-safai — operation kab karna hai, apne doctor ke saath tay kariye
✅ Research mein garmi ke mahino mein infection ka farak bahut thoda paaya gaya hai
✅ Operation se ek din pehle ya usi din sabun se nahaiye
✅ Ghaav ko saaf aur sookha rakhiye — laali, sujan, pus ya bukhaar ho toh turant doctor ko dikhaiye

Darr nahi, taiyaari!
